title: Healthy Herbed Dutch Chicken Skewers
description: A low-calorie Dutch dish featuring chicken skewers with herbed mother sauce, served with rice paper sheets, perfect for a healthy dinner option.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together mother sauce, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the chopped parsley and dill to the bowl and stir to combine.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with the herbed mother sauce mixture.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the rice paper sheets by soaking them in water for 30 seconds.
Serve the grilled chicken skewers with the rice paper sheets and additional herbed mother sauce for dipping.
